name: Gaza

related_people.name: Samson
related_people.role: carried off the city gates by night, and later died pulling down its temple

description: A major Philistine city where Samson, blinded and enslaved after Delilah's betrayal, pulled down the temple of Dagon on himself and thousands of Philistines gathered there (Judges 16:21-30).
family_friendly_summary: Gaza was a Philistine city where Samson was held as a blind prisoner after Delilah betrayed the secret of his strength. When the Philistines gathered in their temple to celebrate, Samson prayed to God for strength one last time and pushed apart the pillars, and the whole building came down.
